description: Reserve a file and get a one-time upload address (PUT the bytes there). Use when storing a file. Before: a bucket id, the file size and the SHA-256 of its bytes. Returns an upload id (upl_...) and a one-time address; PUT the exact bytes there, then call commit_upload. Scope: storage:write. Cost: stored bytes are billed from the prepaid balance (get_pricing).

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request (8-128 chars). Reuse it on retry.

key.description: File path in the bucket, no leading /.

size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

name: start_upload
title: Start an upload
